_comment: ADR-0036. Objects committed migrations DECLARE that are legitimately absent from prod (superseded / renamed / dropped out of band). Every entry is verified fail-closed at run time: the gate FAILS if an allowlisted object is actually PRESENT in prod (a stale waiver must not mask a real object), and FAILS if a key names no active category. Reviewed, with reasons; keep it shrinking. Format: { "<kind>": ["identifier", ...] } where identifier matches the gate's normalized form (tables/types bare-lowercase; rls_enabled `schema.table`).
